items.title: Targeting the DFG-out conformation of TTBK1 enables the discovery of selective type II neuroprotective inhibitors.
items.summary: Tau Tubulin Kinase 1 (TTBK1) is an emerging therapeutic target for neurodegenerative diseases because it promotes the pathological phosphorylation of tau and TDP-43, key drivers of Alzheimer's disease (AD) and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). However, the development of selective TTBK1 inhibitors is hindered by the high structural similarity between TTBK1 and the essential paralog TTBK2, making ATP-competitive strategies challenging. Here, we report the discovery of computationally supported type II TTBK1 inhibitors by targeting the inactive DFG-out kinase conformation. A druggable DFG-out model was generated using metadynamics and molecular dynamic simulations and employed for virtual screening of the MBC chemical library. This approach identified novel chemotypes that were validated as selective TTBK1 inhibitors with improved discrimination over TTBK2. The most promising compounds also displayed neuroprotective activity in SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma cells. These findings demonstrate that targeting the inactive TTBK1 conformation is a viable strategy to achieve isoform selectivity and establish a new framework for developing disease-modifying therapies for ALS, AD, and other TTBK1-driven neurodegenerative disorders.

items.titleZh: 靶向TTBK1的DFG-out构象可实现选择性II型神经保护抑制剂的发现
items.summaryZh: 研究团队通过计算机模拟构建TTBK1失活态（DFG-out）结构模型，并据此虚拟筛选化合物库，发现了一类对TTBK1选择性优于TTBK2的II型抑制剂；其中部分候选化合物在SH-SY5Y细胞中显示出神经保护作用。该工作为绕过TTBK1/TTBK2高度相似难题提供了新思路。
items.insight: TTBK1是连接tau与TDP-43病理的潜在靶点，但因其与TTBK2高度同源，选择性抑制剂开发长期受限。该研究以DFG-out变构构象为切入点获得亚型选择性分子，为ALS治疗化学探针和先导化合物提供了可验证的新起点，值得关注后续选择性、安全性和体内药效数据。

items.abstractZh: Tau微管蛋白激酶1（TTBK1）是神经退行性疾病的新兴治疗靶点，因其促进tau和TDP-43的病理性磷酸化，而这两者是阿尔茨海默病（AD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的关键驱动因素。然而，TTBK1与必需旁系同源物TTBK2之间高度结构相似，阻碍了选择性TTBK1抑制剂的开发，使ATP竞争性策略面临挑战。在此，我们报道通过靶向失活DFG-out激酶构象，发现经计算支持的II型TTBK1抑制剂。利用元动力学和分子动力学模拟生成可成药的DFG-out模型，并将其用于MBC化学库的虚拟筛选。该方法鉴定出新型化学型，经证实为选择性TTBK1抑制剂，对TTBK2的区分度提高。最有前景的化合物还在SH-SY5Y神经母细胞瘤细胞中表现出神经保护活性。这些发现表明，靶向失活TTBK1构象是实现亚型选择性的可行策略，并为开发针对ALS、AD及其他TTBK1驱动的神经退行性疾病的疾病修饰疗法建立了新框架。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于近期提出靶向TTBK1失活构象以实现亚型选择性的新策略，直接针对ALS相关的TDP-43/tau病理，具有转化潜力。

items.title: Immunometabolic dysregulation of reactive microglia and astrocytes in neurodegenerative diseases: Mechanistic insights and therapeutic implications.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDDs) are increasingly understood as multifactorial disorders characterized by intertwined pathological processes, in which metabolic dysfunction may act as a critical and potentially disease-amplifying contributor to the proteinopathy-driven pathological cascade. Despite growing recognition that microglial and astrocytic metabolism governs central nervous system tissue damage-repair homeostasis, intercellular metabolic crosstalk between glia and neurons remains insufficiently synthesized across major NDDs. This review delineates how core metabolic pathways, including glycolysis, mitochondrial respiration, lipid processing, and amino acid transport, shape glial reactivity in Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. We highlight glial metabolic reprogramming, a proposed theoretical framework arising from severe glial metabolic dysregulation. Within this framework, persistent pathological stress may drive reactive glia to sequester local energy substrates in excess, which is hypothesized to trigger bioenergetic failure in neighboring neurons. Broad-spectrum anti-inflammatory agents show poor clinical performance because they only block cytokine outputs rather than reverse glial metabolic exhaustion. Therapeutic efforts should therefore shift toward restoring glial metabolic flexibility. Cell-type-specific metabolic reprogramming, instead of pan-metabolic suppression, may circumvent systemic adverse effects. Precision strategies targeting such intercellular metabolic imbalance could provide promising cell-resolved metabolic avenues to retard NDD progression.
items.titleZh: 神经退行性疾病中反应性小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞的免疫代谢失调：机制见解与治疗意义
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述提出，在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化中，反应性小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞的核心代谢通路（糖酵解、线粒体呼吸、脂质加工、氨基酸转运）发生重编程，可能过度摄取局部能量底物，导致邻近神经元能量衰竭。作者认为广谱抗炎药疗效不佳是因为只阻断细胞因子而未逆转胶质细胞代谢耗竭，建议转向细胞类型特异性的代谢重编程策略而非泛代谢抑制。
items.insight: 该文将ALS纳入AD、PD并列的神经退行性疾病框架，提出胶质细胞代谢重编程和细胞间代谢串扰是疾病放大的关键环节，为ALS神经炎症研究提供了从“抗炎”转向“代谢修复”的新思路，并提示细胞类型特异性干预可能规避全身性副作用，值得关注后续验证性研究。

aiRead.keyFinding: 提出胶质细胞代谢重编程框架：持续病理应激驱动反应性胶质细胞过度隔离能量底物，可能导致邻近神经元生物能量衰竭；广谱抗炎药因未逆转代谢耗竭而疗效不佳。
aiRead.limitation: 为理论性综述，所提框架和假设尚未经原始实验或临床试验直接验证，缺乏定量证据。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续针对小胶质细胞/星形胶质细胞细胞类型特异性代谢重编程在ALS模型或临床中的验证研究。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病（NDDs）日益被视为由相互交织的病理过程所表征的多因素疾病，其中代谢功能障碍可能是蛋白质病变驱动病理级联反应中的关键且可能放大疾病的因素。尽管越来越多的人认识到小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞的代谢调控着中枢神经系统组织损伤-修复稳态，但胶质细胞与神经元之间的细胞间代谢串扰在主要NDDs中仍未得到充分整合。本综述阐述了核心代谢途径（包括糖酵解、线粒体呼吸、脂质加工和氨基酸转运）如何塑造阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化中胶质细胞的反应性。我们强调胶质细胞代谢重编程，这是由严重胶质细胞代谢失调所提出的理论框架。在该框架中，持续的病理应激可能驱动反应性胶质细胞过度隔离局部能量底物，据推测这会触发邻近神经元的生物能量衰竭。广谱抗炎药物临床表现不佳，因为它们仅阻断细胞因子输出，而非逆转胶质细胞代谢耗竭。因此，治疗努力应转向恢复胶质细胞代谢灵活性。细胞类型特异性代谢重编程而非泛代谢抑制，可能规避全身性不良反应。针对这种细胞间代谢失衡的精准策略可能提供有前景的细胞分辨率代谢途径，以延缓NDD进展。
items.frontierRationale: 新近综述整合了ALS中胶质细胞免疫代谢失调机制，并提出细胞类型特异性代谢重编程的转化方向。

items.title: Expanding Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Genetic Spectrum via Systematic Screening of Adult-Onset Neurologic Disease Genes.
items.summary: Emerging evidence indicates that amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) shares genetic architecture with other neurologic disorders, whose causal variants may be overlooked by targeted sequencing. Here, we evaluated the occurrence of pathogenic variants in genes linked to adult-onset neurologic disorders among individuals with ALS. Short-read WGS was performed in retrospectively collected ALS (Gold Coast criteria) and primary lateral sclerosis (PLS) (consensus diagnostic criteria) patients consecutively recruited at an Italian tertiary referral center (2013-2023), extensively phenotyped to exclude mimics. Pathogenic or likely pathogenic single-nucleotide variants/indels (American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics guidelines) and short tandem repeat expansions across 453 genes, including established ALS genes and other neurodegenerative disease genes, were systematically screened and validated. C9orf72 expansions (>30 repeats) were routinely screened by fragment analysis and repeat-primed PCR. A total of 856 patients with ALS and PLS (median age at onset 61.8 years, 38.5% women) were enrolled. Among them, 168 (19.6%) carried pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants or short tandem repeat expansions in genes associated with adult-onset neurologic disorders, mostly autosomal dominant. Of these, 41 (4.8% of the cohort) harbored variants in non-ALS/frontotemporal dementia (FTD) genes (ataxias, neuropathies, myopathies, movement disorders, mitochondrial diseases, and hereditary spastic paraplegia [HSP]). Repeat expansions accounted for 11.9% of cases, while 0.6% carried both sequence variants and repeat expansions. Family history of ALS/FTD ( p = 2.132e-06), other neurodegenerative disorders ( p = 0.0006934), and earlier age at onset ( p = 0.024) were enriched among variant carriers. Variants in genes associated with upper motor neuron (UMN) involvement (ataxias/HSP) did not predict an UMN-predominant phenotype (odds ratio 1.54, 95% CI 0.39-6.07, p = 0.54), while the association between neuropathy/myopathy genes and a lower motor neuron-predominant phenotype was not statistically estimable. Beyond established ALS pathways, enrichment was observed in mitochondrial, metabolic, and proteostasis pathways (false discovery rate ≤0.05). Although the absence of a control cohort limits assessment of variant enrichment, the identification of pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in genes associated with adult-onset neurologic disorders other than ALS/FTD in patients with ALS supports the inclusion of broader gene panels to advance precision medicine in ALS.
items.titleZh: 通过系统筛查成人起病神经系统疾病基因扩展肌萎缩侧索硬化的遗传谱
items.summaryZh: 这项在856例ALS和PLS患者中开展的全基因组测序研究系统筛查了453个基因，发现19.6%的患者携带与成人起病神经系统疾病相关的致病或可能致病变异，其中4.8%涉及非ALS/FTD基因（如共济失调、神经病、肌病、线粒体病和HSP相关基因）。研究还发现线粒体、代谢和蛋白稳态通路存在富集，提示ALS遗传谱比既往认识更广。
items.insight: 该研究提示，对ALS患者进行更广泛的神经遗传学基因筛查可发现被常规靶向面板遗漏的致病变异，有助于解释部分患者的非典型表型、家族史和早发特征，并为精准医学分层和遗传咨询提供依据。其通路富集结果也为线粒体、代谢和蛋白稳态机制研究提供了人类遗传学线索。

items.abstractZh: 新出现的证据表明，肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）与其他神经系统疾病共享遗传架构，其致病性变异可能被靶向测序所遗漏。本研究评估了ALS个体中与成人起病神经系统疾病相关基因的致病性变异的发生情况。对2013至2023年间在意大利一家三级转诊中心连续招募的、经广泛表型分析以排除模拟疾病的ALS（Gold Coast标准）和原发性侧索硬化（PLS）（共识诊断标准）患者，进行了回顾性收集的短读长全基因组测序。系统筛查并验证了453个基因中的致病性或可能致病性单核苷酸变异/插入缺失（美国医学遗传学与基因组学学会指南）及短串联重复扩增，包括已确立的ALS基因和其他神经退行性疾病基因。C9orf72扩增（>30次重复）通过片段分析和重复引物PCR常规筛查。共纳入856例ALS和PLS患者（发病中位年龄61.8岁，38.5%为女性）。其中，168例（19.6%）携带与成人起病神经系统疾病相关基因的致病性或可能致病性变异或短串联重复扩增，大多为常染色体显性。其中，41例（占队列4.8%）携带非ALS/额颞叶痴呆（FTD）基因（共济失调、神经病、肌病、运动障碍、线粒体疾病和遗传性痉挛性截瘫[HSP]）的变异。重复扩增占病例的11.9%，而0.6%同时携带序列变异和重复扩增。ALS/FTD家族史（p = 2.132e-06）、其他神经退行性疾病家族史（p = 0.0006934）和较早发病年龄（p = 0.024）在变异携带者中富集。与上运动神经元（UMN）受累相关的基因（共济失调/HSP）变异不能预测UMN为主表型（比值比1.54，95% CI 0.39-6.07，p = 0.54），而神经病/肌病基因与下运动神经元为主表型之间的关联无法进行统计学估计。除已确立的ALS通路外，还观察到线粒体、代谢和蛋白稳态通路的富集（错误发现率≤0.05）。尽管缺乏对照组限制了变异富集的评估，但在ALS患者中鉴定出与ALS/FTD以外的成人起病神经系统疾病相关的基因的致病性或可能致病性变异，支持纳入更广泛的基因面板以推进ALS的精准医学。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的大样本全基因组筛查，扩展了ALS的遗传谱并提示更广泛基因面板的转化价值。

items.title: Robustness of Plasma P-Tau217 Diagnostic Thresholds for Alzheimer Disease Across Various Clinical Populations and Laboratory Environments.
items.summary: Blood-based biomarkers (BBMs), especially plasma tau phosphorylated at threonine 217 (p-tau217), could scale Alzheimer disease (AD) clinical-biological diagnosis, but clinical use requires thresholds transferable across laboratories and populations. We compared Lumipulse p-tau217 with other BBMs; evaluated amyloid-anchored thresholds across centers, analyzers, reagent lots, and clinical populations; and assessed second-line CSF adjudication of gray zone results. This multicenter, cross-sectional diagnostic-classification study included an exploratory Brussels cohort and 3 external validation cohorts. Brussels participants were cognitively unimpaired or impaired and had Aβ status determined by amyloid-PET or CSF Aβ42 and tau status by tau-PET or CSF p-tau181. Validation cohorts comprised consecutive Paris memory-clinic patients, patients with early-onset neurodegenerative dementia in Bordeaux, and individuals with monogenic frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD). Plasma p-tau217 was measured locally on Lumipulse analyzers. BBMs and ratios were compared using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analyses. In Brussels, a Youden cutoff and dual 95% or 97.5% sensitivity/specificity cutoffs were derived; intermediate values defined gray zones. Among 411 participants (mean age 70.5 years; 51.6% female), p-tau217 showed the best diagnostic performance; p-tau217/Aβ42 did not improve performance or reduce gray zones. In Brussels, p-tau217 discriminated Aβ+ from Aβ- status (AUC 0.96, 95% CI 0.93-0.98; p < 0.0001). The 0.193 pg/mL Youden cutoff (95% CI 0.178-0.213) yielded 91.5% sensitivity (95% CI 84.7-95.5) and 91.6% specificity (95% CI 84.8-95.5) and detected neocortical tau-PET positivity with 98.5% sensitivity and 81.8% specificity. In Paris, sensitivity/specificity for clinical-biological AD were 93.2% (95% CI 85.1-97.1)/93.0% (95% CI 81.4-97.6); in Bordeaux, sensitivity/specificity for clinical-biological AD were 95.7% (95% CI 79.0-99.2)/92.3% (95% CI 66.7-98.6). Specificity in monogenic FTLD was 88.4% (95% CI 75.5-94.9). False-positive classifications were enriched in FTLD with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Dual thresholds yielded gray zones in 15.4%-24.8% of Paris patients; second-line CSF testing resolved 86.2%-88.9% of gray zone cases. Lumipulse plasma p-tau217 thresholds were transferable across centers, analyzers, reagent lots, and heterogeneous clinical populations, supporting evaluation of plasma-first pathways with confirmatory testing for gray zone values. Values below 0.193 pg/mL made neocortical tauopathy unlikely. Limitations include cross-sectional design, specialized Western European recruitment, unavailable race/ethnicity data, heterogeneous reference standards, incomplete AD copathology adjudication in monogenic FTLD, and no cross-platform comparison.
items.titleZh: 血浆P-Tau217诊断阈值在不同临床人群和实验室环境中的稳健性
items.summaryZh: 这项多中心横断面研究评估了Lumipulse血浆p-tau217在布鲁塞尔探索队列及巴黎、波尔多和单基因FTLD验证队列中的诊断阈值可转移性。p-tau217对Aβ状态区分能力最佳（AUC 0.96），0.193 pg/mL截断值在多个队列中保持较高灵敏度和特异度；合并ALS的FTLD患者中假阳性较多，灰区结果可通过二线CSF检测大部分裁定。
items.insight: 该研究直接涉及ALS相关鉴别诊断问题：合并ALS的FTLD患者更容易出现血浆p-tau217假阳性，提示在ALS/FTLD谱系中解读AD血液标志物时需谨慎，并支持对灰区结果进行CSF确认。对ALS研究者而言，这有助于理解血浆p-tau217作为AD共病理标志物在ALS-FTLD连续谱中的特异性边界。

items.abstractZh: 血液生物标志物（BBM），尤其是血浆苏氨酸217磷酸化tau（p-tau217），有望扩大阿尔茨海默病（AD）临床-生物学诊断的应用规模，但临床使用要求阈值能够在不同实验室和人群之间转移。我们比较了Lumipulse p-tau217与其他BBM；评估了以淀粉样蛋白为锚定的阈值在不同中心、分析仪、试剂批次和临床人群间的表现；并评估了灰区结果的二线脑脊液（CSF）裁定。这项多中心、横断面诊断分类研究包括一个探索性布鲁塞尔队列和3个外部验证队列。布鲁塞尔参与者认知正常或受损，其Aβ状态由淀粉样蛋白PET或CSF Aβ42确定，tau状态由tau-PET或CSF p-tau181确定。验证队列包括巴黎记忆门诊连续患者、波尔多早发性神经退行性痴呆患者以及单基因额颞叶变性（FTLD）个体。血浆p-tau217在本地Lumipulse分析仪上检测。使用受试者工作特征（ROC）分析比较BBM及其比值。在布鲁塞尔，推导了Youden截断值以及95%或97.5%灵敏度和特异度的双重截断值；中间值定义为灰区。在411名参与者（平均年龄70.5岁；51.6%女性）中，p-tau217表现出最佳诊断性能；p-tau217/Aβ42未改善性能或减少灰区。在布鲁塞尔，p-tau217可区分Aβ+与Aβ-状态（AUC 0.96，95% CI 0.93-0.98；p < 0.0001）。0.193 pg/mL的Youden截断值（95% CI 0.178-0.213）产生91.5%灵敏度（95% CI 84.7-95.5）和91.6%特异度（95% CI 84.8-95.5），并以98.5%灵敏度和81.8%特异度检测新皮质tau-PET阳性。在巴黎，临床-生物学AD的灵敏度/特异度为93.2%（95% CI 85.1-97.1）/93.0%（95% CI 81.4-97.6）；在波尔多，临床-生物学AD的灵敏度/特异度为95.7%（95% CI 79.0-99.2）/92.3%（95% CI 66.7-98.6）。单基因FTLD中的特异度为88.4%（95% CI 75.5-94.9）。假阳性分类在合并肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的FTLD中富集。双重阈值在15.4%-24.8%的巴黎患者中产生灰区；二线CSF检测解决了86.2%-88.9%的灰区病例。Lumipulse血浆p-tau217阈值可在不同中心、分析仪、试剂批次和异质性临床人群之间转移，支持评估血浆优先路径并对灰区值进行确认检测。低于0.193 pg/mL的值使新皮质tau病变不太可能。局限性包括横断面设计、西欧专门招募、种族/民族数据不可用、参考标准异质性、单基因FTLD中AD共病理裁定不完整以及无跨平台比较。
items.frontierRationale: 该多中心研究新近验证了血浆p-tau217阈值跨实验室和人群的可转移性，并特别揭示合并ALS的FTLD中假阳性富集，对ALS相关鉴别诊断具有转化参考价值。

items.title: Health-Related Quality of Life Across Neurologic Conditions: A Cross-Sectional Cohort Study Using Real-World Patient-Reported Outcomes.
items.summary: Health-related quality of life (HRQOL) is an important outcome within value-based care for patients with neurologic conditions. The American Academy of Neurology recommends the use of Patient-Reported Outcomes Measurement Information System (PROMIS) Global Health as a patient-reported outcome performance measure to assess stability or improvement over 1 year. However, interpretation of this measure requires an understanding of HRQOL across neurologic populations. Our study leveraged real-world data collected through the electronic health record to characterize differences in HRQOL across common neurologic conditions. This is a cross-sectional study of adult patients with 1 of 10 conditions (amyotrophic lateral sclerosis [ALS], back pain, brain tumor, dementia, major depression, epilepsy, migraine, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson disease, and stroke) who completed patient-reported outcomes as standard care between October 2015 and March 2023 at a large Neurologic Institute. Patients completed PROMIS-GH, from which physical and mental summary scores (Global Mental Health [GMH], Global Physical Health [GPH]) were calculated, PHQ-9 depression screen, and condition-specific measures. EQ-5D utility index was estimated from PROMIS-GH. These were summarized across conditions after adjustment for demographics, clinical characteristics, and self-reported condition-specific severity. There were 133,636 patients included in this analysis (mean age 51.5 [SD ± 18] years, 64% female, 81% White race). Overall adjusted average scores for GPH, GMH, PHQ-9, and EQ-5D were 42.7 ± 5.0, 43.6 ± 5.0, 7.9 ± 3.7, and 0.68 ± 0.11, respectively. Scores were significantly different across condition, with GPH ranging from 39.6 ± 5.5 for back pain to 45.9 ± 3.9 for brain tumor. Patients with brain tumor, back pain, stroke, ALS, and multiple sclerosis had more favorable GMH and PHQ-9 scores, while patients with depression, epilepsy, and dementia had the most affected GMH and PHQ-9 scores. Patients with back pain and headache had the lowest EQ-5D scores (0.63 ± 0.13 and 0.67 ± 0.09), while those with brain tumor had the highest (0.77 ± 0.08). This study provides condition-specific and severity-specific benchmarks for PROMIS-GH and related HRQOL measures that can support interpretation of patient-reported outcomes across neurologic populations. These data inform clinical care, quality measurement, research, and the implementation of the AAN-recommended performance measure.
items.evidenceLevel: 观察性临床研究（横断面队列）
items.titleZh: 神经系统疾病中的健康相关生活质量：一项使用真实世界患者报告结局的横断面队列研究
items.summaryZh: 该横断面研究基于13万余例神经系统疾病患者的真实世界电子健康记录数据，建立了PROMIS全球健康量表及EQ-5D等生活质量指标在10种疾病中的基准值。ALS患者被纳入分析，其心理健康和抑郁筛查评分相对较好，但研究未单独报告ALS的身体健康评分具体数值。这些基准有助于解读ALS及其他神经疾病患者的生活质量数据。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS领域提供了一个来自大型真实世界队列的生活质量参照基准，有助于未来在ALS临床试验和临床照护中解读PROMIS-GH等患者报告结局，判断干预是否带来有意义的改善。但需注意这是横断面观察性数据，不能用于推断ALS疾病进展或治疗效果。

aiRead.studyType: 横断面观察性队列研究，利用电子健康记录中的患者报告结局数据
aiRead.keyFinding: 在133,636例神经疾病患者中，PROMIS全球健康及EQ-5D评分因疾病不同而存在显著差异；ALS患者心理健康和PHQ-9评分相对较好，研究提供了疾病和严重程度特异性基准值。
aiRead.limitation: 横断面设计无法反映随时间的变化或因果推断；样本以白人女性为主，外推性受限；ALS亚组的具体评分未在摘要中单独列出。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续基于该基准的纵向研究或ALS专病队列分析，以及PROMIS-GH作为美国神经病学学会推荐绩效指标在ALS临床实践中的实施效果。

items.abstractZh: 健康相关生活质量（HRQOL）是神经系统疾病患者价值导向医疗中的重要结局指标。美国神经病学学会推荐使用患者报告结局测量信息系统（PROMIS）全球健康量表作为患者报告结局绩效指标，以评估1年内的稳定或改善情况。然而，解读该指标需要了解不同神经病人群的HRQOL状况。本研究利用通过电子健康记录收集的真实世界数据，描述常见神经系统疾病之间HRQOL的差异。这是一项横断面研究，纳入2015年10月至2023年3月期间在一家大型神经病学研究所作为标准诊疗完成患者报告结局的成人患者，涵盖10种疾病之一（肌萎缩侧索硬化[ALS]、背痛、脑肿瘤、痴呆、重度抑郁、癫痫、偏头痛、多发性硬化、帕金森病和卒中）。患者完成PROMIS-GH，据此计算身体和心理健康综合评分（全球心理健康[GMH]、全球身体健康[GPH]）、PHQ-9抑郁筛查及疾病特异性量表。EQ-5D效用指数由PROMIS-GH估算。在调整人口学特征、临床特征和自我报告的疾病特异性严重程度后，对这些指标按疾病进行汇总。本分析共纳入133,636例患者（平均年龄51.5[SD ± 18]岁，64%女性，81%白人）。GPH、GMH、PHQ-9和EQ-5D的总体调整平均分分别为42.7 ± 5.0、43.6 ± 5.0、7.9 ± 3.7和0.68 ± 0.11。各疾病间评分存在显著差异，GPH从背痛的39.6 ± 5.5到脑肿瘤的45.9 ± 3.9不等。脑肿瘤、背痛、卒中、ALS和多发性硬化患者的GMH和PHQ-9评分较为有利，而抑郁、癫痫和痴呆患者的GMH和PHQ-9评分受影响最大。背痛和头痛患者的EQ-5D评分最低（分别为0.63 ± 0.13和0.67 ± 0.09），脑肿瘤患者最高（0.77 ± 0.08）。本研究为PROMIS-GH及相关HRQOL指标提供了疾病特异性和严重程度特异性的基准值，可支持跨神经病人群患者报告结局的解读。这些数据为临床诊疗、质量测量、研究以及美国神经病学学会推荐绩效指标的实施提供信息。
items.frontierRationale: 基于大规模真实世界患者报告结局数据，为包括ALS在内的神经疾病建立生活质量基准，具有支持患者报告结局标准化解读的转化价值。

items.title: Sephin1 protects from glutamate stress, consistent with negative allosteric modulation of GluN2B-containing NMDA receptor.
items.summary: Glutamate excitotoxicity and GluN2B containing N-methyl-d-aspartate receptors (NMDARs) are involved in neurodegenerative diseases such as Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis, Parkinson disease and Alzheimer disease. Recently, Sephin1, a first-in-class, multi-functional, brain-penetrant, orally administered small molecule, has been demonstrated in vitro to improve motor neurons survival following glutamate intoxication. In ALS animal models, Sephin1 was able to reduce motor neuron loss, to improve motor function and increase animal survival. To determine how Sephin1 can reduce motor neurons loss following glutamate intoxication, calcium flux was measured in primary cortical neurons and in GluN1A/GluN2B overexpressing cells following NMDA stimulation. Then, to determine the binding site on GluN1 and GluN2B subunits, binding assays were performed with three benzylideneaminoguanidine derivatives, Sephin1, guanabenz and IFB-048. Here, for the first time, we show that Sephin1 reduces calcium flux in NMDA stimulated primary cortical neurons in a dose dependent manner. Sephin1, guanabenz and IFB-048 reduce the rise of calcium flux in GluN1A/GluN2B subunits overexpressing cells stimulated with NMDA. In addition, we demonstrated that Sephin1, guanabenz and IFB-048, displace ifenprodil from the N-terminal domain (NTD) of NMDAR (GluN1/GluN2B) containing the polyamine site on GluN2B subunits. The three benzylideneaminoguanidine derivatives could possibly be Negative Allosteric Modulator (NAM) of GluN2B-containing NMDARs.
items.titleZh: Sephin1 对谷氨酸应激具有保护作用，与对含 GluN2B 的 NMDA 受体的负向变构调节一致
items.summaryZh: 该研究在细胞层面探索 Sephin1 减轻谷氨酸兴奋性毒性的机制。结果显示，Sephin1 可剂量依赖性地降低 NMDA 刺激引起的原代皮层神经元钙内流，并在过表达 GluN1A/GluN2B 的细胞中抑制钙流升高；Sephin1、胍那苄和 IFB-048 均可将艾芬地尔从含 GluN2B 的 NMDAR N 端结构域置换出来。作者据此提出，这些苄叉氨基胍衍生物可能是含 GluN2B 的 NMDAR 的负向变构调节剂。
items.insight: 该研究为 Sephin1 在 ALS 模型中的神经保护作用提供了可能的分子机制解释：其作用可能部分通过负向变构调节含 GluN2B 的 NMDA 受体、降低谷氨酸兴奋性毒性实现。这有助于将 Sephin1 的临床前获益与明确的受体药理学联系起来，并为评估 GluN2B 靶向策略在 ALS 中的转化潜力提供依据。

aiRead.studyType: 体外细胞机制研究（原代皮层神经元及过表达 GluN1A/GluN2B 的细胞）
aiRead.keyFinding: Sephin1 剂量依赖性降低 NMDA 诱导的神经元钙流，并与胍那苄、IFB-048 一样置换 NMDAR N 端结构域的艾芬地尔结合，提示其为含 GluN2B 的 NMDAR 负向变构调节剂。
aiRead.limitation: 证据来自细胞体系，不能直接证明临床疗效；结合位点与负向变构调节的结论仍需进一步的功能与结构研究验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续需关注 Sephin1 在 ALS 动物模型中的受体药理学验证，以及含 GluN2B 的 NMDAR 负向变构调节策略的转化研究进展。

items.abstractZh: 谷氨酸兴奋性毒性和含 GluN2B 的 N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸受体（NMDARs）参与肌萎缩侧索硬化、帕金森病和阿尔茨海默病等神经退行性疾病。近期，Sephin1——一种首创的、多功能的、可透过血脑屏障的口服小分子——已在体外被证明可改善谷氨酸中毒后的运动神经元存活。在 ALS 动物模型中，Sephin1 能够减少运动神经元丢失、改善运动功能并提高动物生存率。为确定 Sephin1 如何减少谷氨酸中毒后的运动神经元丢失，研究者在 NMDA 刺激后，于原代皮层神经元和过表达 GluN1A/GluN2B 的细胞中测量了钙流。随后，为确定其在 GluN1 和 GluN2B 亚基上的结合位点，研究者用三种苄叉氨基胍衍生物——Sephin1、胍那苄和 IFB-048——进行了结合实验。本文首次显示，Sephin1 以剂量依赖方式降低 NMDA 刺激的原代皮层神经元中的钙流。Sephin1、胍那苄和 IFB-048 可降低经 NMDA 刺激的过表达 GluN1A/GluN2B 亚基细胞中钙流的升高。此外，研究者证明 Sephin1、胍那苄和 IFB-048 可将艾芬地尔从含 GluN2B 亚基上多胺位点的 NMDAR（GluN1/GluN2B）N 端结构域（NTD）置换出来。这三种苄叉氨基胍衍生物可能是含 GluN2B 的 NMDARs 的负向变构调节剂（NAM）。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了 Sephin1 与含 GluN2B 的 NMDA 受体负向变构调节相关的机制，为 ALS 中谷氨酸兴奋性毒性干预提供了可跟踪的转化线索。

items.title: Limited contribution of natural killer cells to SOD1 G93A ALS pathogenesis: evidence from comprehensive immunophenotyping and genetic deletion of Ncr1 and Properdin .
items.summary: Immune dysregulation contributes to amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) pathogenesis. Natural killer (NK) lymphocytes have been proposed to contribute to ALS, but their exact role remains debated. Here we combined comprehensive immunophenotyping strategy with two complementary loss-of-function approaches to trace NK cells and assess their Ncr1-associated cytotoxic function in SOD1 G93A mice. We found no significant difference in the proportion, maturation, and activation status of circulating NK cells between control and SOD1 G93A mice at onset and symptomatic stage, and no significant NK cell recruitment to the central nervous system at any disease stage. Notably, resident microglia in the SOD1 G93A spinal cord acquire NK1.1 expression at the symptomatic stage. NK cells isolated from SOD1 G93A mice did not affect motoneuron survival in vitro . We further show that genetic deletion of Ncr1 , which abolishes one of the major activating pathways of NK-cell cytotoxicity, did not modify disease onset, motor function or survival of SOD1 G93A mice. Additionally, we show that Properdin, a positive regulator of the alternative complement pathway and a reported ligand of NCR1, decorates misfolded SOD1 inclusions and degenerating astrocytes, consistent with a role as a phagocytic signal for CD68 + microglia. However, genetic deletion of Properdin in SOD1 G93A did not influence neuroinflammation or motoneuron survival. Together, the unchanged frequency, maturation or activation status of NK cells, combined with the lack of effect of Ncr1 genetic ablation argue against a major NK contribution to motoneuron degeneration in the SOD1 G93A mouse model, while uncovering an unexpected role for Properdin in opsonizing misfolded SOD1 aggregates.
items.titleZh: 自然杀伤细胞对SOD1 G93A ALS发病机制的贡献有限：来自全面免疫表型分析和Ncr1与Properdin基因缺失的证据
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1 G93A ALS小鼠模型中系统追踪NK细胞，发现其数量、成熟度、活化状态及向中枢神经系统的募集均无显著变化；敲除NK细胞主要活化受体Ncr1不影响疾病发病、运动功能或生存；体外NK细胞也不影响运动神经元存活。研究不支持NK细胞在该模型中驱动运动神经元变性。另一方面，补体替代途径正调控因子Properdin可标记错误折叠SOD1聚集体和退变星形胶质细胞，但敲除Properdin同样不影响神经炎症和运动神经元存活。
items.insight: 这项研究以多种功能缺失策略较系统地否定了NK细胞在SOD1 G93A模型中的主要致病作用，有助于研究者避免将NK细胞作为该模型的核心治疗靶点；同时提示Properdin对错误折叠SOD1的调理作用值得在蛋白聚集清除和胶质细胞吞噬机制中进一步追踪。

aiRead.studyType: 动物/细胞实验（SOD1 G93A小鼠模型，免疫表型分析及Ncr1、Properdin基因敲除）
aiRead.keyFinding: SOD1 G93A小鼠中NK细胞频率、成熟度、活化及中枢募集无显著改变，Ncr1或Properdin基因敲除均不影响疾病进程；Properdin可标记错误折叠SOD1包涵体和退变星形胶质细胞。
aiRead.limitation: 证据仅来自SOD1 G93A小鼠模型和体外实验，不能直接外推至其他ALS遗传亚型或人类患者；NK细胞作用被否定不等于其他免疫细胞或补体通路无贡献。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注Properdin调理错误折叠SOD1聚集体对小胶质细胞吞噬清除的影响，以及在其他ALS模型或人源体系中验证NK细胞和补体通路的作用。

items.abstractZh: 免疫失调参与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的发病机制。自然杀伤（NK）淋巴细胞被认为可能参与ALS，但其确切作用仍存争议。本研究将全面的免疫表型分析策略与两种互补的功能缺失方法相结合，以追踪SOD1 G93A小鼠中的NK细胞并评估其与Ncr1相关的细胞毒功能。我们发现，在发病期和症状期，对照小鼠与SOD1 G93A小鼠之间循环NK细胞的比例、成熟度和活化状态均无显著差异，且在任何疾病阶段均未观察到NK细胞显著募集至中枢神经系统。值得注意的是，SOD1 G93A小鼠脊髓中的驻留小胶质细胞在症状期获得NK1.1表达。从SOD1 G93A小鼠分离的NK细胞在体外不影响运动神经元存活。我们进一步表明，基因敲除Ncr1（该基因缺失可消除NK细胞细胞毒性的主要激活通路之一）并未改变SOD1 G93A小鼠的疾病发病、运动功能或生存。此外，我们显示Properdin——替代补体通路的正调控因子及据报道的NCR1配体——装饰错误折叠的SOD1包涵体和退变星形胶质细胞，符合其作为CD68+小胶质细胞吞噬信号的作用。然而，在SOD1 G93A中基因敲除Properdin并未影响神经炎症或运动神经元存活。综上，NK细胞频率、成熟度或活化状态未变，加之Ncr1基因消融无效应，反对NK细胞对SOD1 G93A小鼠模型运动神经元变性有主要贡献，同时揭示了Properdin在调理错误折叠SOD1聚集体中的意外作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究以Ncr1和Properdin基因敲除结合免疫表型分析，新近厘清了NK细胞在SOD1 G93A ALS模型中的有限贡献，并提示Properdin调理SOD1聚集体的潜在转化线索。

items.source: Biometals : an international journal on the role of metal ions in biology, biochemistry, and medicine
items.title: Microglial perturbation in heavy metal-induced neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration: mechanisms, phenotypic plasticity, and therapeutic prospects.
items.summary: Heavy metal exposure has emerged as a significant environmental contributor to neurodegenerative disease, and a substantial body of mechanistic evidence implicates microglia in the pathological cascades that follow. Lead, cadmium, arsenic, manganese, copper, cobalt, mercury, and zinc disrupt central nervous system homeostasis through multiple cellular targets, but the resident innate immune cells of the brain are well placed to translate these insults into sustained neuroinflammation. Evidence for this critical narrative review was assembled through a purposive search of PubMed, MEDLINE, and Google Scholar for mechanistically informative studies reporting glial endpoints, with reference lists searched by hand and no systematic protocol applied. This review synthesizes current understanding of how individual metals engage microglial signaling networks, with particular attention to oxidative stress, NF-κB activation, NLRP3 inflammasome assembly, MAPK cascades, and suppression of the Nrf2 antioxidant axis. We examine the phenotypic spectrum that extends well beyond the classical M1/M2 dichotomy, including disease-associated microglia, lipid-droplet-accumulating microglia, and interferon-responsive states, and consider how metal-specific signatures map onto these transcriptional programs. Manganese-driven inflammasome assembly, cadmium-induced mitochondrial impairment, lead-mediated disruption of calcium homeostasis, and mercury-evoked autophagic dysfunction are discussed as illustrative examples of mechanistic divergence within a common neuroinflammatory framework. Glial responses to metal mixtures, which better represent real exposure than single-element designs, are considered separately, and the evidence for greater-than-additive effects is appraised. Downstream consequences for astrocyte reactivity, blood-brain barrier integrity, synaptic remodeling, and neuronal viability are placed in the context of Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Therapeutic avenues are appraised, including chelation, natural antioxidants, NLRP3 inhibitors, TREM2 modulation, and microglial replacement strategies. Methodological constraints, particularly the overreliance on BV-2 cells and acute high-dose exposure paradigms, are critically considered. The review concludes by identifying priorities for translational research, including longitudinal human cohort studies, single-cell transcriptomic profiling of metal-exposed microglia, and the development of region-specific exposure models that better reflect chronic environmental realities.

items.titleZh: 重金属诱导的神经炎症与神经退行性变中的小胶质细胞扰动：机制、表型可塑性与治疗前景
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述系统梳理了铅、镉、砷、锰、铜、钴、汞、锌等重金属如何通过氧化应激、NF-κB、NLRP3炎症小体、MAPK和Nrf2等通路扰动小胶质细胞，进而推动神经炎症和神经退行性变。文章强调小胶质细胞表型远不止M1/M2，还涉及疾病相关小胶质细胞、脂滴蓄积型和干扰素反应状态，并讨论了金属混合物的超加性效应。文中将上述机制与阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和ALS联系起来，评估了螯合、抗氧化剂、NLRP3抑制剂、TREM2调节和小胶质细胞替代等治疗方向，同时指出当前研究过度依赖BV-2细胞和急性高剂量暴露模型的局限。
items.insight: ALS研究者可从中获得环境暴露与小胶质细胞促炎表型之间的机制框架，尤其是NLRP3、TREM2和金属混合物超加性效应等可检验节点；文章提出的单细胞转录组和区域特异性慢性暴露模型，也为ALS环境病因学研究提供了方法学方向。

aiRead.keyFinding: 多种重金属通过氧化应激、NF-κB、NLRP3、MAPK和Nrf2等通路扰动小胶质细胞，驱动持续性神经炎症，并与阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和ALS的下游病理过程相关联。

items.abstractZh: 重金属暴露已成为神经退行性疾病的重要环境贡献因素，大量机制性证据表明小胶质细胞参与其后的病理级联反应。铅、镉、砷、锰、铜、钴、汞和锌通过多种细胞靶点破坏中枢神经系统稳态，而脑内驻留的固有免疫细胞恰好处于将这些损伤转化为持续性神经炎症的关键位置。本叙述性综述的证据通过针对PubMed、MEDLINE和Google Scholar的目的性检索汇集，纳入报告胶质终点的机制性信息研究，并手工检索参考文献列表，未采用系统化方案。本综述综合了当前关于各金属如何介入小胶质细胞信号网络的认识，特别关注氧化应激、NF-κB激活、NLRP3炎症小体组装、MAPK级联以及Nrf2抗氧化轴的抑制。我们考察了远超经典M1/M2二分法的表型谱，包括疾病相关小胶质细胞、脂滴蓄积型小胶质细胞和干扰素反应状态，并探讨金属特异性特征如何映射到这些转录程序上。锰驱动的炎症小体组装、镉诱导的线粒体损伤、铅介导的钙稳态破坏以及汞引发的自噬功能障碍，作为共同神经炎症框架内机制分歧的示例性证据加以讨论。金属混合物的胶质反应——比单元素设计更接近真实暴露——被单独讨论，并评估了超加性效应的证据。对星形胶质细胞反应性、血脑屏障完整性、突触重塑和神经元存活的下游后果，置于阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化症的背景下讨论。评估的治疗途径包括螯合疗法、天然抗氧化剂、NLRP3抑制剂、TREM2调节和小胶质细胞替代策略。方法学局限，特别是对BV-2细胞和急性高剂量暴露范式的过度依赖，受到批判性审视。综述最后确定了转化研究的优先事项，包括纵向人类队列研究、金属暴露小胶质细胞的单细胞转录组分析，以及更能反映慢性环境现实的区域特异性暴露模型的开发。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了重金属暴露下小胶质细胞表型可塑性与ALS等神经退行性疾病的机制联系，并明确提出单细胞转录组和慢性暴露模型等转化研究优先事项。

items.title: Current rehabilitation approaches in ALS/MND and use of digital health technology; an international survey of occupational therapists and physiotherapists.
items.summary: Occupational Therapists (OTs) and Physiotherapists (PTs) provide rehabilitation at all stages of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS)/motor neurone disease (MND), but research is limited on current rehabilitation practice. In particular, little is known about digital health technology use, which is increasingly available in healthcare. This international online survey investigated current rehabilitation practices and digital health technology use among OTs and PTs. A 46-question survey consisting of open- and closed-ended questions targeted OTs and PTs through professional bodies, special interest groups, and social media. Questions explored symptom management, treatment strategies, and digital health technology use in ALS/MND. Quantitative data were analyzed primarily using descriptive statistics, while open-ended questions were qualitatively analyzed using thematic analysis. There were 240 responses from 16 countries (OTs = 85; PTs = 155). Respondents worked in ALS/MND for a median of 8 years (IQR 11). Fatigue (61.3%) and spasticity (45%) were the top symptoms often/always managed by respondents. OTs more frequently managed cognition, with PTs more frequently managing cough and secretions, pain, and prescribed exercise (stretches, strengthening, and aerobic). The majority (89%, n = 213) screened for falls. Only a minority (27%, n = 65) used digital health technology in ALS/MND. This survey investigated the current rehabilitation approaches and digital health technology use among OTs and PTs in ALS/MND. The survey confirmed the diverse and varied roles of OTs and PTs, with overlap in fatigue and spasticity management. Digital health technology use was low among OTs and PTs. These findings can inform future research into rehabilitation practices among OTs and PTs and digital health technologies development in ALS/MND.
items.evidenceLevel: 横断面国际在线调查（描述性研究，证据等级待人工判定）
items.titleZh: ALS/MND当前康复方法及数字健康技术的使用：一项针对作业治疗师和物理治疗师的国际调查
items.summaryZh: 这项国际在线调查收集了来自16个国家240名作业治疗师和物理治疗师的回复，了解他们在ALS/MND中的康复实践。结果显示，疲劳和痉挛是最常处理的症状；作业治疗师更多处理认知问题，物理治疗师更多处理咳嗽、分泌物、疼痛和处方运动；89%的受访者进行跌倒筛查；仅27%在ALS/MND中使用数字健康技术。调查揭示了康复角色的多样性与重叠，以及数字健康技术使用率偏低的现状。
items.insight: 该调查提供了ALS/MND多学科康复实践的真实世界国际图景，明确了当前康复重点（疲劳、痉挛、跌倒筛查）和数字健康技术的低使用率，为设计康复干预研究和数字健康工具开发提供了需求依据和基线数据。

aiRead.studyType: 国际横断面在线调查（定量描述统计+开放式问题主题分析）
aiRead.keyFinding: 240名来自16个国家的作业治疗师和物理治疗师中，疲劳和痉挛是最常管理的症状，89%进行跌倒筛查，但仅27%在ALS/MND中使用数字健康技术。
aiRead.limitation: 为自报告在线调查，存在选择偏倚和回复偏倚；样本以特定专业群体为主，不能代表所有康复从业者；未评估数字健康技术使用与患者结局的关系。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续基于该调查结果开展的康复实践干预研究，以及针对ALS/MND数字健康技术开发与可行性验证的转化研究。

items.abstractZh: 作业治疗师（OTs）和物理治疗师（PTs）在肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）/运动神经元病（MND）的各阶段提供康复服务，但关于当前康复实践的研究有限。特别是，随着数字健康技术在医疗保健中日益普及，人们对其使用情况知之甚少。这项国际在线调查旨在了解OTs和PTs当前的康复实践及数字健康技术使用情况。调查包含46个问题，由开放式和封闭式问题组成，通过专业机构、特殊兴趣小组和社交媒体面向OTs和PTs发放。问题涉及ALS/MND的症状管理、治疗策略及数字健康技术使用。定量数据主要采用描述性统计分析，开放式问题采用主题分析法进行定性分析。共收到来自16个国家的240份回复（OTs=85；PTs=155）。受访者从事ALS/MND工作的中位年限为8年（IQR 11）。疲劳（61.3%）和痉挛（45%）是受访者经常/总是处理的主要症状。OTs更常处理认知问题，PTs更常处理咳嗽和分泌物、疼痛以及处方运动（拉伸、力量训练和有氧运动）。大多数（89%，n=213）进行了跌倒筛查。仅少数（27%，n=65）在ALS/MND中使用数字健康技术。本调查研究了ALS/MND中OTs和PTs当前的康复方法及数字健康技术使用情况。调查证实了OTs和PTs多样且各异的作用，在疲劳和痉挛管理方面存在重叠。OTs和PTs中数字健康技术的使用率较低。这些发现可为未来关于OTs和PTs康复实践的研究以及ALS/MND数字健康技术的开发提供参考。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，首次以国际调查形式系统描绘ALS/MND康复中数字健康技术的使用现状，为后续数字化康复工具的转化开发提供了需求基线。

items.title: Prevalence of C9orf72 hexanucleotide repeat expansions in a Mexican cohort of sporadic and familial amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Objective: Pathological hexanucleotide repeat expansions (HRE) in the C9orf72 gene (≥30 repeats) are one of the most common genetic causes of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) in European and North American populations. However, there is limited data on the size and distribution of C9orf72 HRE in admixed populations such as those found in Latin America. In this study, we sought to characterize the role of C9orf72 HRE in a Mexican cohort with ALS. Methods: Peripheral blood samples were obtained from participants of Mexican ancestry attending a multidisciplinary ALS clinic in Northern Mexico ( n = 102) and healthy neurological controls ( n = 75). We performed high-resolution repeat-primed PCR to determine the size and distribution of HRE per allele across both groups. In addition, we used two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests to compare allele-level HRE repeat size distributions between ALS cases, healthy controls and a comparative external dataset. Results: We identified three patients (2.9%) carrying pathological C9orf72 repeat expansions, of which two had a family history of ALS and asymptomatic family members with pathological C9orf72 expansions. Notably, all three patients originated from the same region in Northern Mexico. Kolmogorov-Smirnov testing did not identify statistically significant differences between ALS cases, healthy controls, and a comparative dataset. Conclusions: Our findings suggest that pathological C9orf72 expansions may not be a common genetic variant in this population. Additional studies are needed to confirm this observation, as well as determine whether regional genetic variation may play an important role in genetic risk stratification, particularly in admixed ALS populations.
items.titleZh: 墨西哥散发性和家族性肌萎缩侧索硬化队列中C9orf72六核苷酸重复扩增的患病率
items.summaryZh: 该研究在墨西哥北部102例ALS患者和75例健康对照中检测C9orf72六核苷酸重复扩增，发现仅2.9%（3例）携带病理性扩增，且3例均来自同一地区，其中2例有ALS家族史。等位基因重复大小分布在ALS与对照间无显著差异。提示C9orf72病理性扩增在墨西哥混合人群中可能并不常见，遗传风险可能存在区域差异。
items.insight: C9orf72扩增频率在不同 ancestry 人群中差异显著，该研究为拉丁美洲混合人群提供了稀缺的患病率数据，提示在遗传检测和风险分层中需考虑人群特异性，对全球ALS遗传咨询和临床试验入组策略有参考价值。

items.abstractZh: 目的：C9orf72基因的病理性六核苷酸重复扩增（HRE，≥30次重复）是欧洲和北美人群中肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）最常见的遗传病因之一。然而，在拉丁美洲等混合人群中对C9orf72 HRE的大小和分布数据有限。本研究旨在表征C9orf72 HRE在墨西哥ALS队列中的作用。方法：从墨西哥北部一家多学科ALS门诊就诊的墨西哥裔参与者（n=102）和健康神经科对照（n=75）获取外周血样本。我们采用高分辨率重复引物PCR确定两组中每个等位基因HRE的大小和分布。此外，我们使用双样本Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验比较ALS病例、健康对照和外部比较数据集之间的等位基因水平HRE重复大小分布。结果：我们识别出3例携带病理性C9orf72重复扩增的患者（2.9%），其中2例有ALS家族史，且有无症状家庭成员携带病理性C9orf72扩增。值得注意的是，所有3例患者均来自墨西哥北部同一地区。Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验未发现ALS病例、健康对照和比较数据集之间存在统计学显著差异。结论：我们的发现提示病理性C9orf72扩增在该人群中可能不是常见的遗传变异。需要进一步研究来确认这一观察结果，并确定区域遗传变异是否可能在遗传风险分层中发挥重要作用，特别是在混合 ancestry 的ALS人群中。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近提供了墨西哥混合人群中C9orf72扩增的低患病率数据，对ALS遗传风险分层的区域差异具有转化参考价值。

items.title: TIP60-mediated acetylation remodels pathological FUS condensates and promotes lysosome-dependent clearance.
items.summary: Phase separation and pathological cytoplasmic accumulation of FUS mutants are central features of FUS-associated amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS); yet, the mechanisms that regulate FUS mutant condensate dynamics and efficient clearance remain largely unclear. Here, we identify the lysine acetyltransferase TIP60 as a selective modifier of FUS mutant condensates. TIP60 preferentially associated with FUS R495X mutant condensates and reduced the condensate formation, while having minimal effects on wild-type FUS. TIP60 activation promoted FUS R495X degradation predominantly through the lysosome-dependent pathway. Acetylation proteomics identified FUS K312 as the major site acetylated by TIP60. Acetylation mimicry at K312 suppressed aberrant FUS R495X phase separation, accelerated lysosome-dependent clearance of aggregated FUS R495X, and attenuated FUS R495X-induced cytotoxicity. These findings suggest that TIP60 activation as a potential therapeutic strategy for FUS-associated ALS.
items.evidenceLevel: 细胞水平临床前研究（体外机制研究）
items.titleZh: TIP60介导的乙酰化重塑病理性FUS凝聚体并促进溶酶体依赖性清除
items.summaryZh: 该研究在细胞模型中筛选并鉴定出乙酰转移酶TIP60能选择性作用于FUS R495X突变体凝聚体，而非野生型FUS。TIP60通过乙酰化FUS第312位赖氨酸（K312），抑制异常相分离，并促进突变体经溶酶体途径清除，从而减轻细胞毒性。作者据此提出激活TIP60可能作为FUS相关ALS的治疗思路。
items.insight: FUS相关ALS目前缺乏针对凝聚体清除环节的干预手段。该研究把“乙酰化修饰—相分离调控—溶酶体清除”串联成一条可操作的分子通路，并定位到K312这一具体位点，为后续验证TIP60激活剂或K312乙酰化模拟策略提供了明确的起点。但证据目前仅来自细胞模型，距离治疗验证尚有距离。

items.abstractZh: FUS突变体的相分离和病理性胞质积聚是FUS相关肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的核心特征；然而，调控FUS突变体凝聚体动态及高效清除的机制在很大程度上仍不清楚。在此，我们鉴定赖氨酸乙酰转移酶TIP60为FUS突变体凝聚体的选择性修饰因子。TIP60优先与FUS R495X突变体凝聚体结合并减少凝聚体形成，而对野生型FUS影响极小。TIP60激活主要促进FUS R495X通过溶酶体依赖性途径降解。乙酰化蛋白质组学鉴定出FUS K312为TIP60乙酰化的主要位点。K312位点的乙酰化模拟抑制了异常的FUS R495X相分离，加速了聚集态FUS R495X的溶酶体依赖性清除，并减轻了FUS R495X诱导的细胞毒性。这些发现提示，激活TIP60可能是FUS相关ALS的潜在治疗策略。
items.frontierRationale: 新近鉴定了TIP60-K312乙酰化轴作为FUS突变体凝聚体清除的可调控节点，为FUS相关ALS提供了具有转化潜力的治疗靶点方向。

items.title: Lower frequency ECoG features improve longitudinal stability of speech and hand-grasp detection in a patient with progressive ALS.
items.summary: Objective. Achieving long-term decoding stability is a critical challenge for chronic intracranial brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). High-gamma (HG) activity from intracranial recordings is the standard signal for BCI control, and lower-frequency features can enhance HG decoding performance. This study evaluated the longitudinal stability of speech and hand-grasp detection models using individual and joint spectral features, and the local motor potential (LMP). Approach. Longitudinal data from a single participant implanted with two 64-channel electrocorticographic arrays were used to evaluate the long-term stability of logistic regression models for speech and hand-grasp detection. Models were trained on individual frequency bands and on the LMP, a time-domain low-frequency feature, and evaluated over 21 months for speech and 13 months for grasp. The best-performing band features were then combined into multi-band models and analyzed for their spatial contributions. Main Results. The LMP yielded the most accurate single feature models in both tasks (speech 93.8%, grasp 99.4%) and showed little or no decline. Multi-band models combining HG with lower frequency bands were substantially more stable than HG-only models and outperformed the LMP models for speech but not grasp. HG accuracy degraded strongly for both tasks (speech:-4.3 percentage points per 100 days, or pp/100 d, grasp:-3.4 pp/100 d). HG+beta for speech showed a negligible decline (0.5 pp/100 d, 95.60.06% overall), and for grasp, delta alone showed remarkable stability (+0.5 pp/100 d), while HG+beta+delta maintained 98.20.09% overall accuracy with flat performance (+0.0 pp/100 d). The advantage of the multi-band models increased over time, reaching +20.6 pp for speech and +10.2 pp for grasp in the last 100 days. Significance. Incorporating lower-frequency neural activity yields more stable long-term speech and grasp detection than HG alone. These findings indicate that lower-frequency and multi-band features may reduce recalibration requirements for simple BCI tasks, and may complement the precision control provided by HG activity. Clinical Trial Information. ClinicalTrials.gov, registration number NCT03567213.

items.titleZh: 较低频率ECoG特征改善进行性ALS患者语音和抓握检测的纵向稳定性
items.summaryZh: 该研究利用一名进行性ALS患者植入的双64通道ECoG阵列，纵向评估语音和抓握解码模型在21个月（语音）和13个月（抓握）内的稳定性。结果显示，仅依赖高伽马活动的模型准确率随时间明显下降，而纳入beta、delta等较低频率特征的多频带模型稳定性显著更好，在语音任务中甚至优于低频时域特征LMP。研究者认为，低频及多频带特征有望减少BCI重新校准需求，并可与高伽马活动形成互补。

items.abstractZh: 目的。实现长期解码稳定性是慢性颅内脑机接口（BCI）面临的关键挑战。颅内记录的高伽马（HG）活动是BCI控制的标准信号，而较低频率特征可增强HG解码性能。本研究评估了使用单独及联合频谱特征以及局部运动电位（LMP）的语音和抓握检测模型的纵向稳定性。方法。使用一名植入两个64通道皮层电图阵列的参与者的纵向数据，评估用于语音和抓握检测的逻辑回归模型的长期稳定性。模型在单独频带和LMP（一种时域低频特征）上训练，语音评估历时21个月，抓握评估历时13个月。随后将表现最佳的频带特征组合成多频带模型，并分析其空间贡献。主要结果。LMP在两项任务中均产生最准确的单一特征模型（语音93.8%，抓握99.4%），且几乎没有或没有下降。将HG与较低频带组合的多频带模型比仅HG模型显著更稳定，在语音任务中优于LMP模型，但在抓握任务中未优于LMP模型。HG准确率在两项任务中均强烈退化（语音：每100天-4.3个百分点，即pp/100 d；抓握：-3.4 pp/100 d）。语音的HG+beta显示可忽略的下降（0.5 pp/100 d，总体95.6±0.06%），抓握中单独delta表现出显著稳定性（+0.5 pp/100 d），而HG+beta+delta维持总体准确率98.2±0.09%且性能平稳（+0.0 pp/100 d）。多频带模型的优势随时间增加，在最后100天语音达到+20.6 pp，抓握达到+10.2 pp。意义。纳入较低频率神经活动比仅HG产生更稳定的长期语音和抓握检测。这些发现表明，较低频率和多频带特征可能减少简单BCI任务的重新校准需求，并可能补充HG活动提供的精确控制。临床试验信息。ClinicalTrials.gov，注册号NCT03567213。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究在2026年发表，针对进行性ALS患者的慢性ECoG脑机接口，提出低频多频带特征可提升长期解码稳定性，具有明确的BCI转化价值。

items.title: Persistent bilateral STAU1 elevation accompanies increases in p62, GFAP, and phosphorylated tau after traumatic brain injury.
items.summary: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) is a major cause of long-term neurological disability and increases the risk of neurodegeneration and post-traumatic epileptogenesis. However, the molecular mechanisms responsible for sustained secondary injury and network dysfunction beyond the initial impact remain poorly understood. Staufen-1 (STAU1), an RNA-binding protein that controls mRNA decay, trafficking, and localization to subcellular compartments, is pathologically overabundant in multiple neurodegenerative disease models, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, dementia, and ataxias. Whether STAU1 abundance is altered following moderate controlled cortical impact (CCI), and whether these changes occur alongside increases in p62/SQSTM1, glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP), and phosphorylated tau, remains unknown. Here, using Western blot analyses, we found that STAU1 is persistently elevated in both the ipsilateral hemisphere, including the injury and perilesional regions, and the contralateral cerebrum at 48-h, 1-week, and 1-month post-injury. These increases are accompanied by accumulation of the autophagy adaptor protein p62/SQSTM1, which may suggest changes in p62 synthesis, degradation, or autophagic cargo burden. In parallel, glial fibrillary acidic protein levels as well as phosphorylated tau levels are elevated bilaterally and remain increased 1-month after injury. Together, these findings show a persistent overaccumulation of STAU1 protein levels at several acute time points from 48-h through 1-month after TBI, the first evidence of a previously overlooked factor in the evolving molecular architecture after brain injury. The combination of elevated STAU1, p62, gliosis, and phosphorylated tau in our TBI model provides a basis for future studies on whether STAU1 contributes to injury-associated changes in protein homeostasis and neurological dysfunction, including post-traumatic epilepsy.

items.abstractZh: 创伤性脑损伤（TBI）是长期神经功能障碍的主要原因，并增加神经退行性变和创伤后癫痫发生的风险。然而，在初始撞击之后导致持续性继发性损伤和网络功能障碍的分子机制仍知之甚少。Staufen-1（STAU1）是一种RNA结合蛋白，控制mRNA降解、运输和亚细胞定位，在多种神经退行性疾病模型（包括肌萎缩侧索硬化、痴呆和共济失调）中病理性过度丰富。在中度控制性皮层撞击（CCI）后STAU1丰度是否改变，以及这些变化是否与p62/SQSTM1、胶质纤维酸性蛋白（GFAP）和磷酸化tau的增加同时发生，仍不清楚。在此，我们使用Western blot分析发现，STAU1在损伤后48小时、1周和1个月时在同侧半球（包括损伤区和病灶周围区域）以及对侧大脑中持续升高。这些增加伴随自噬衔接蛋白p62/SQSTM1的积累，这可能提示p62合成、降解或自噬货物负荷的变化。同时，胶质纤维酸性蛋白水平以及磷酸化tau水平双侧升高，并在损伤后1个月仍保持增加。总之，这些发现表明STAU1蛋白水平在TBI后48小时至1个月的多个急性时间点持续过度积累，这是脑损伤后演变中的分子结构中一个先前被忽视的因素的首个证据。在我们的TBI模型中STAU1、p62、胶质增生和磷酸化tau的联合升高，为未来研究STAU1是否参与损伤相关的蛋白质稳态变化和神经功能障碍（包括创伤后癫痫）提供了基础。
items.frontierRationale: 该动物模型研究新近揭示TBI后STAU1持续升高并与ALS相关病理标志（p62、磷酸化tau）共存，为RNA代谢异常连接脑损伤与神经退行性变提供了转化研究线索。

items.title: Motor neuron disease due to a novel PIK3R1 mutation.
items.summary: Mutations in PIK3R1, which encodes the regulatory subunit (p85α) of class I phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K), are associated with immunologic and developmental disorders, but their effects on the nervous system have not been studied. We identified a novel heterozygous frameshift mutation (PIK3R1 c.1710dup) in a patient with common variable immunodeficiency who developed adult-onset, slowly progressive ALS-like motor-neuron disease. Studies of patient-derived induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) demonstrated PIK3R1 haploinsufficiency with selective AKT activation. Investigation of patient's iPSC-derived motor neurons (iMNs) showed reduced neuronal electrical activity, and markedly increased apoptosis. Single-cell RNA sequencing revealed coordinated up-regulation of differentiation and apoptosis programs across neuronal and glial clusters. Engineering the PIK3R1 c.1710dup mutation into healthy-control iPSCs reproduced the impaired electrical activity, increased apoptosis, and transcriptional vulnerability, confirming the variant's cell-intrinsic pathogenicity. In contrast, introduction of canonical APDS2-associated PIK3R1 splice mutations into the same genetic background did not produce these abnormalities, establishing a variant-class-specific mechanism of PI3K dysfunction. Together, these findings define PIK3R1 c.1710dup as a distinct pathogenic variant that links PI3K-pathway dysregulation to human motor-neuron degeneration and expands the mechanistic spectrum of PIK3R1-associated disease.
items.titleZh: 一种新型PIK3R1突变导致的运动神经元病
items.summaryZh: 研究在一名常见变异型免疫缺陷患者中发现新型PIK3R1移码突变（c.1710dup），该患者表现为成人起病、缓慢进展的ALS样运动神经元病。患者iPSC来源运动神经元显示电活动降低和凋亡增加；将该突变引入健康对照iPSC可重现上述异常，而经典APDS2相关PIK3R1剪接突变不能重现，提示该变异具有细胞内在致病性且机制与变异类型相关。

items.abstractZh: PIK3R1编码I类磷酸肌醇3-激酶（PI3K）的调节亚基（p85α），其突变与免疫和发育障碍相关，但其对神经系统的影响尚未被研究。我们在一名患有常见变异型免疫缺陷、并出现成人起病、缓慢进展的ALS样运动神经元病的患者中，鉴定出一种新型杂合移码突变（PIK3R1 c.1710dup）。对患者来源的诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）的研究显示，PIK3R1单倍剂量不足并伴有选择性AKT激活。对患者iPSC来源的运动神经元（iMNs）的研究显示，神经元电活动降低，凋亡显著增加。单细胞RNA测序揭示，神经元和胶质细胞簇中分化和凋亡程序协同上调。将PIK3R1 c.1710dup突变工程化引入健康对照iPSCs，重现了电活动受损、凋亡增加和转录脆弱性，证实了该变异的细胞内在致病性。相反，将经典APDS2相关PIK3R1剪接突变引入相同遗传背景，并未产生这些异常，从而确立了PI3K功能障碍的变异类别特异性机制。总之，这些发现将PIK3R1 c.1710dup定义为一种独特的致病性变异，将PI3K通路失调与人类运动神经元变性联系起来，并拓展了PIK3R1相关疾病的机制谱。
items.frontierRationale: 新近在Brain报道的细胞模型研究，首次将新型PIK3R1 c.1710dup变异与人类运动神经元变性联系起来，具有ALS相关遗传机制和转化研究价值。

items.title: Chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan 4 participates in the internalization of arginine-rich dipeptide repeat proteins.
items.summary: Microsatellite repeat expansion of the 5' GGGGCC 3' sequence in the C9orf72 gene is the most common monogenic form of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia. Dipeptide repeat proteins (DPRs) translated from the mutant allele can be detected in postmortem brains of afflicted individuals. The arginine containing peptides, poly proline-arginine (poly-PR) and poly glycine-arginine (poly-GR), are particularly noxious to cells. Both can undergo cell-to-cell transmission, but underlying mechanisms are not understood. We found rapid internalization and nucleolar localization of bath-applied hemagglutinin (HA) tagged poly-PR with twenty repeats (HA-PR 20 ) in cell lines and neurons. Small molecule and RNAi approaches implicated a temperature-dependent, fluid phase endocytosis mechanism for HA-PR 20 . We sought to identify DPR-related cell surface uptake factors using µMap high-resolution proximity labeling. DPR-iridium conjugates identified candidate cell-surface proteins which were interrogated in a secondary RNAi screen. Focusing on our strongest candidate, chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan 4 (CSPG4), we showed cellular uptake of HA-PR 20 is reduced by inhibition of glycosaminoglycan chain synthesis and knockdown or ablation of CSPG4. Knockdown of CSPG4 protected PR 20 -induced neuronal toxicity. Using a dual reporter system to interrogate in vitro neuron-to-neuron transmission of PR 50, we found PR 50 synthesized by one neuron readily spread to neighboring cells. Transmission was significantly reduced with CSPG4 knockdown. Similarly conditioned media from PR 50 or GR 50 expressing neurons contained transmissible protein that was internalized into neurons in a CSPG4-dependent manner. These results suggest CSPG4 participates in poly-PR/poly-GR internalization and transmission.
items.titleZh: 硫酸软骨素蛋白聚糖4参与富含精氨酸二肽重复蛋白的内化
items.summaryZh: 该研究在细胞和神经元模型中揭示，C9orf72相关毒性二肽重复蛋白poly-PR和poly-GR的细胞摄取与神经元间传播依赖细胞表面蛋白CSPG4；抑制CSPG4可减少摄取并减轻PR20诱导的神经毒性。

items.abstractZh: C9orf72基因5' GGGGCC 3'序列的微卫星重复扩增是肌萎缩侧索硬化症和额颞叶痴呆最常见的单基因形式。由突变等位基因翻译产生的二肽重复蛋白（DPRs）可在患者死后脑组织中检测到。含精氨酸的肽段——聚脯氨酸-精氨酸（poly-PR）和聚甘氨酸-精氨酸（poly-GR）——对细胞尤其有害。两者均可发生细胞间传播，但其潜在机制尚不清楚。我们发现，在细胞系和神经元中，外源施加的带有血凝素（HA）标签、含二十个重复的poly-PR（HA-PR20）可快速内化并定位于核仁。小分子和RNAi方法提示HA-PR20通过温度依赖的液相内吞机制进入细胞。我们利用µMap高分辨率邻近标记技术寻找与DPR相关的细胞表面摄取因子。DPR-铱偶联物鉴定出候选细胞表面蛋白，并在二次RNAi筛选中对这些蛋白进行了验证。聚焦于最强的候选分子——硫酸软骨素蛋白聚糖4（CSPG4），我们证明抑制糖胺聚糖链合成以及敲低或敲除CSPG4均可减少HA-PR20的细胞摄取。敲低CSPG4可保护神经元免受PR20诱导的毒性。利用双报告系统研究体外神经元间PR50的传递，我们发现一个神经元合成的PR50可轻易扩散至邻近细胞。敲低CSPG4后，这种传递显著减少。同样，来自表达PR50或GR50的神经元的条件培养基中含有可传播的蛋白，其以CSPG4依赖的方式被神经元内化。这些结果提示CSPG4参与poly-PR/poly-GR的内化和传播。
items.frontierRationale: 新近鉴定了CSPG4作为C9orf72二肽重复蛋白内化与传播的关键细胞表面因子，为ALS中阻断毒性蛋白扩散提供了可转化的新靶点。
